correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact campaign Eq.(12), the physical parameter range and unique endemic root. Integrating d log I, dS, dI and d logit p against a recurrent invariant law yields four exact averages. Normalized delay kernel forces E(G*p)=E p; algebra yields the denominator identity and reciprocal-variance equality. Strictness follows from Jensen and constancy implying equilibrium; all boundary requirements stated. Standalone SymPy proof-step check and independent Erlang-2 solve_ivp diagnostic passed. Finite simulation does not certify a cycle.

value.rationale: The underlying 2023 paper studies stability and delay-dependent oscillations of childhood vaccination but does not quantify how endemic infection averaged over a recurrent regime differs from endemic-equilibrium prevalence. The exact mean-prevalence discount has a sharp campaign switch η=0 versus η>0, a physically interpretable inverse-uptake variance statistic, and holds without a small-amplitude or prescribed memory-shape restriction. This is a motivated structural burden law; not routine equilibrium calculation or an arbitrary finite slice.
